title: Degradation graph and or prediction
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 1
Participant 2
comments.body:
You are right: As soon as we make our app "connected", we will get a rather large tail of constraints to handle to make this "the right way".

Although any user must upload his data 100% willingly I think that the stored data itself will need some extra protection we could hardly guarantee. And then, as you already mentioned, we would need to ask to be allowed to handle such a database ... to be 100% legally ...

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: Would storing in file in a users PERSONAL google drive be OK?

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: Probably, but I think putting a file there from within the app automatically will not be trivial. To be tested ... I've never done that ...

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: I skimmed this https://developers.google.com/drive/android/ Not VERY hard it seems, and I am slightly unsure about the keys required and if OAuth can be automated to ones own identity. Or I should maybe say: I am 100% that can be done, but unsure about the complexities :-)

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
I am now leaning to a similar, but alternative approach, What about using a well established IoT service like thingsspeak? Strictly personal, I don't want to have to do with ANY storage responsibility myself.

Mildly related: next version of CanZE needs to have Internet access in the manifest as it needs to be able to access a Wemos Gateway or an emulator. I have already drafted a note on that change for the users on the CanZE website.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: I have made a draft note on MQTT on the CanZE website. Don't get me wrong, this is NOT a given. I am OK with not publishing that all. But I do like the idea and for sure I am going to implement it on the WeMos

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
Even without heaving read it right now,
I think "why not". Maybe someone gets inspired ;)


Bob

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
I am closing this issue. MQTT is on the back burner as far as I am concerned, in the sense that I will implement it on the WiFi gateway first. As we will not implement a degradation function in CanZE itself for the reasons stated above, there is no need to keep this issue open.

I do expect keen interest from a few number-keen users to push for MQTT and implement the most interesting graphs and stuff on degradation cloud based later on.
